app.name: Biblisann
app.tagline: Your physical library, in your pocket.

auth.name: Name
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Pick a passphrase, not a word.
auth.mfaHelp: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
auth.resetSent: If this address has an account, a link was sent.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. You can sign in.

sso.refused: This identity is not allowed to sign in here (is its email verified?).

auth.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be used.

library.empty: No books yet. Scan your first one!
library.firstRun: Create your first library to start adding books.
library.name: Library name

scan.title: Scan books
scan.cameraError: The camera is not available. Type the ISBN instead.
scan.notIsbn: This is not a book barcode (ISBN).
scan.placeSet: Place set: the next books go there.

loans.lendHint: To lend one of your books, open it in your library.

places.title: Places
places.name: Place name
places.inventoryHelp: Scan or paste the ISBNs of the books you find here to see what is missing.

settings.tokensHelp: Tokens let scripts and AI tools (MCP) use your library. A token never exceeds your own rights.
settings.shownOnce: Copy it now, it is shown only once:
settings.backupHelp: The archive contains password hashes: store it safely.
settings.pushFailed: This device could not be subscribed (was the permission refused?).
settings.confirmEmail: Enter the code we emailed to this address:

book.lent: Lent. It is listed under Loans.

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app, then enter a code.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.recoveryOnce: Recovery codes, shown once. Each works once if you lose your device:

oauth.title: Allow {{client}} to use your library?
oauth.explain: This application will act on your behalf through MCP. It can never do more than you can.
oauth.librariesHelp: None ticked means all your libraries.
oauth.invalid: This authorization request is invalid. Close this page.
oauth.redirectsTo: After you approve, your browser is sent to:
oauth.unverified: Anyone can register an application under any name. Only continue if you started this connection yourself and recognise this address.

account.dataHelp: Export everything you own as one file (libraries you administer, lists, reading, grades, contacts) and import it again here or on another server.
account.importLibrary: Import a library export as a new library
account.deleteWarning: This deletes your account and the libraries only you use. It cannot be undone: export your data first.
account.typeEmail: Type your email address to confirm
account.promote: If I alone administer a shared library, make another member its administrator

admin.confirmDelete: Delete the account {{email}} and the libraries only it uses?
admin.newPassword: New password for {{email}} (also lets single sign-on users sign in locally; signs them out everywhere):

hardcover.title: Hardcover
hardcover.help: Keep your reading status and ratings in step with your Hardcover account. Books are matched by ISBN; if both sides changed a book, the most recent edit wins. Your token is stored encrypted.
hardcover.tokenOptional: New token (leave empty to keep the current one)
hardcover.synced: Done: {{pulled}} updated here, {{pushed}} sent to Hardcover.

sharing.title: Sharing my libraries
sharing.profilesHelp: A profile is a named set of permissions you can give to people or groups instead of a standard role.
sharing.confirmInvite: No account uses {{email}}. Send an invitation to this address?
sharing.invitationCreated: Invitation created (valid 7 days, emailed when the server can send mail). Link:

groups.title: User groups
groups.help: Groups let you share a library with several people at once. OIDC sign-in can fill them automatically.
groups.name: New group name
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group {{name}}? Libraries shared with it are no longer shared with its members.

shelves.title: Shelves
shelves.noPlaces: Create places first (Places page): a shelf is a place, its layers are places inside it.
shelves.hint: Books stand as spines, thicker when they have more pages. Drag a book to another layer, or select it to move it.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.explain: This action is sensitive. Confirm your identity again; it stays unlocked for 5 minutes.
stepUp.sso: Sign in again with single sign-on

invite.title: You are invited to {{library}}
invite.name: Your name
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
invite.done: Done: the library is now in your list.

status.not_found: No provider knows this book. Its data is kept as it is; exclude it from refreshes if you do not want it checked again.
status.no_isbn: No ISBN, so there is nothing to look up. Its data is kept as it is.

bulk.title: Add a list of ISBNs
bulk.placeholder: Paste ISBNs, one per line or separated by commas
bulk.slowing: Slowing down to respect the server limit: next one in {{seconds}} s.

adminCatalog.title: Book metadata refresh
adminCatalog.help: Every week the providers are asked again about books none of them knew. Start a run now for the whole server or one library; books you excluded from refreshes are never touched. Runs in the background, one lookup per second.
adminCatalog.started: Started. It runs in the background.

refresh.started: Started. It runs in the background.
